root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before the final header line is advanced through the Content-family branch, parse_headers() must establish that end - sizeof("Content") + 1 >= p so the seven-byte name advance stays within the current header line.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable program dispatches the final `Cont` line to the Content branch and advances p without proving that seven bytes remain before end. The fixed program enforces this guard through HEADER_LENGTH("Content"); on the original PoC that leaves the required assertion guarded, and the single boundary perturbation `content_name_boundary` supplies the genuine witness where the conjunct holds and the protected inner switch executes.

nodes.state: The immediate inner STRING_SWITCH_L(p) requests a 4-byte string_as_int32() read from p even though fewer than four bytes remain before helper->buffer->value + helper->buffer->len.
After the Content-family branch adds sizeof("Content") - 1, p lies past end of the current header line instead of at or before it.

edges.relation: The out-of-range pointer produced by the unchecked Content advance is the same pointer the immediate inner STRING_SWITCH_L(p) uses as its switch argument.
The Content-family branch transforms p by adding the seven-byte Content name length; the resulting address is exactly the post-advance p observed before the inner switch.
